name: NgTBLaboratoryRegister
title: NG TB Laboratory Register
description:
Logical model for the Nigeria National Tuberculosis and Leprosy Control
Programme NTBLCP/TB 04 TB Laboratory Register for Xpert MTB/RIF assay,
AFB microscopy and other TB diagnostic tests. One model instance represents
a laboratory register and contains repeatable laboratory entries corresponding
to individual patient/specimen rows in the source register.

mapping.name: NG TB Laboratory Register Column Mapping
mapping.comment:
Maps NgTBLaboratoryRegister logical-model elements to the printed
NTBLCP/TB 04 TB Laboratory Register columns.

element.definition:
Logical model for the Nigeria National Tuberculosis and Leprosy Control
Programme NTBLCP/TB 04 TB Laboratory Register for Xpert MTB/RIF assay,
AFB microscopy and other TB diagnostic tests. One model instance represents
a laboratory register and contains repeatable laboratory entries corresponding
to individual patient/specimen rows in the source register.
Identifier assigned to the TB laboratory register or its electronic equivalent.
Reference to the laboratory maintaining the register, when available.
Name of the laboratory maintaining the NTBLCP/TB 04 register.
Local Government Area in which the laboratory is located.
One patient/specimen row in the NTBLCP/TB 04 TB Laboratory Register.
